linkedemployee.title: greytHR
linkedemployee.textSnippet:
Hide Help

You can link a user to an employee. Once linked, the user's email will change to the employee's email. When the employee logs in, he will be given a choice of logging in as a User or as an employee. This will enable him to perform multiple functions from a single login.

Explore greytHR by watching How-to Videos, Help-Doc, and FAQ.
